mil7.4.9:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, Sakkassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.4.9:1.3: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ekantapavivekasukhābhiratena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.9:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja Sakkassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.9:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja Sakko deve disvā paggaṇhāti hāsam-abhijaneti,
mil7.4.9:2.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kusalesu dhammesu alīnam-atanditaṃ santaṃ mānasaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, hāsam-abhijanetabbaṃ, uṭṭhahitabbaṃ ghaṭitabbaṃ vāyamitabbam.
mil7.4.9:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja Sakkassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.9:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja Sakkassa anabhirati na uppajjati,
mil7.4.9:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena suññāgāre anabhirati na uppādetabbā.
mil7.4.9:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja Sakkassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
